description: This Swift source file implements the client logic for push notification registration via a relay service, including handling of app attestation, receipt verification, and network communication with the relay server. It defines error handling, request/response models, and a class to manage push registration lifecycle.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinates the refresh of the app store receipt, utilizing StoreKit's SKRequestDelegate methods.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Handles creation of app attestation proofs using Apple's DCAppAttestService.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Provides the device's app store receipt as a base64 string, refreshing it if necessary.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main client class for handling push relay registration, including fetching challenges, creating attestations, and communicating with the relay server.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Main method to perform push registration, including attestation proof creation, receipt loading, and network request to register the device.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Fetches a challenge from the push relay server to be signed by the device attestation.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Generic method to decode JSON data into specified Decodable types.

methods.name: statusCode
methods.description: Extracts the HTTP status code from URLResponse.

methods.name: normalizeBaseURLString
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from the base URL string for consistency.

methods.name: decodeErrorMessage
methods.description: Parses error message from relay server's error response data.
